title: Draft-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Speculative Draft Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.29343v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by pairing a target model with a lightweight draft model whose proposed tokens are verified in parallel. A common way to build draft models, like EAGLE3 or DFlash is supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on target-generated trajectories. However, we observe that SFT quickly plateaus: the draft model's acceptance length on test data stops improving. The reason is an offline-to-inference mismatch: In SFT, the drafter learns from fixed target-generated trajectories, whereas during speculative decoding it is evaluated on blocks proposed under its own policy. This motivates on-policy distillation (OPD), where the target model supervises the drafter on draft-induced states. translated_title: Draft-OPD：面向投机解码草稿模型的在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 投机解码通过将目标模型与一个轻量级草稿模型配对来加速大语言模型推理，草稿模型提出的词元会被并行验证。构建草稿模型的常见方法（如EAGLE3或DFlash）是在目标模型生成的轨迹上进行监督微调（SFT）。然而，我们观察到SFT很快达到瓶颈：草稿模型在测试数据上的接受长度停止提升。原因在于离线训练与在线推理之间的不匹配：在SFT中，草稿模型从固定的目标模型生成轨迹中学习，而在投机解码过程中，它是在自身策略所提出的词块上进行评估的。这促使我们采用在线策略蒸馏（OPD），即由目标模型在草稿模型诱导产生的状态上对草稿模型进行监督。然而，对草稿模型而言OPD仍然困难，因为它们无法独立可靠地生成完整序列，而借助目标模型辅助生成会使收集到的序列遵循目标分布，从而……
tldr: 该论文提出Draft-OPD方法，通过在线策略蒸馏解决监督微调草稿模型因离线训练与在线推理分布不匹配而快速达到性能瓶颈的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Draft-OPD, which addresses the performance plateau of SFT-trained draft models in speculative decoding—caused by the offline-to-inference mismatch—through on-policy distillation.
